import base64
import calendar
import json
from datetime import datetime
from urllib.parse import quote

from youtube_dl.extractor.fourtube import PornTubeIE


def _build_webpage(video):
    """Encode a fake INITIALSTATE payload the way porntube.com does."""
    payload = {'page': {'video': video}}
    raw_json = json.dumps(payload)
    quoted = quote(raw_json)
    encoded = base64.b64encode(quoted.encode('utf-8')).decode('utf-8')
    assert 'INITIALSTATE' not in encoded
    return (
        '<html><head><script>window.INITIALSTATE = "%s";</script>'
        '</head><body></body></html>' % encoded
    )


def _install_extractor(monkeypatch, ie, webpage, formats=None):
    """Patch the two network/format helpers and return the call logs."""
    if formats is None:
        formats = [{'url': 'https://cdn.example.com/video.mp4', 'format_id': '720'}]

    download_calls = []
    format_calls = []

    def fake_download_webpage(url, video_id, *args, **kwargs):
        download_calls.append((url, video_id))
        return webpage

    def fake_extract_formats(url, video_id, media_id, sources):
        format_calls.append((url, video_id, media_id, list(sources)))
        return formats

    monkeypatch.setattr(ie, '_download_webpage', fake_download_webpage)
    monkeypatch.setattr(ie, '_extract_formats', fake_extract_formats)
    return download_calls, format_calls


def test_real_extract_full_metadata(monkeypatch):
    ie = PornTubeIE()
    url = 'https://www.porntube.com/videos/teen-couple-doing-anal_7089759'
    video = {
        'title': 'Teen couple doing anal',
        'mediaId': 1234567,
        'encodings': [{'height': 720}, {'height': 360}, {'width': 100}],
        'masterThumb': 'https://cdn.example.com/thumb.jpg',
        'user': {'username': 'Alexy', 'id': 91488},
        'channel': {'name': 'ChanName', 'id': 665},
        'likes': '12',
        'dislikes': 3,
        'playsQty': '1234',
        'durationInSeconds': '5052',
        'publishedAt': '2015-06-06 12:34:56',
    }
    webpage = _build_webpage(video)
    formats = [{'url': 'https://cdn.example.com/720.mp4', 'format_id': '720'}]
    download_calls, format_calls = _install_extractor(monkeypatch, ie, webpage, formats)

    result = ie._real_extract(url)

    expected_timestamp = calendar.timegm(datetime(2015, 6, 6, 12, 34, 56).timetuple())
    assert result == {
        'id': '7089759',
        'title': 'Teen couple doing anal',
        'formats': formats,
        'thumbnail': 'https://cdn.example.com/thumb.jpg',
        'uploader': 'Alexy',
        'uploader_id': '91488',
        'channel': 'ChanName',
        'channel_id': '665',
        'timestamp': expected_timestamp,
        'like_count': 12,
        'dislike_count': 3,
        'view_count': 1234,
        'duration': 5052,
        'age_limit': 18,
    }
    assert download_calls == [(url, 'teen-couple-doing-anal')]
    assert format_calls == [

    """Encode a fake INITIALSTATE payload the way porntube.com does."""
    payload = {'page': {'video': video}}
    raw_json = json.dumps(payload)
    quoted = quote(raw_json)

        '</head><body></body></html>' % encoded
    )


def _install_extractor(monkeypatch, ie, webpage, formats=None):
    """Patch the two network/format helpers and return the call logs."""
    if formats is None:
        formats = [{'url': 'https://cdn.example.com/video.mp4', 'format_id': '720'}]

    download_calls = []
    format_calls = []

    def fake_download_webpage(url, video_id, *args, **kwargs):
        download_calls.append((url, video_id))
        return webpage

    def fake_extract_formats(url, video_id, media_id, sources):
        format_calls.append((url, video_id, media_id, list(sources)))
        return formats

def _build_webpage(video):
    """Encode a fake INITIALSTATE payload the way porntube.com does."""
    payload = {'page': {'video': video}}
    raw_json = json.dumps(payload)
    quoted = quote(raw_json)
    encoded = base64.b64encode(quoted.encode('utf-8')).decode('utf-8')

    return (
        '<html><head><script>window.INITIALSTATE = "%s";</script>'
        '</head><body></body></html>' % encoded
    )


def _install_extractor(monkeypatch, ie, webpage, formats=None):
    """Patch the two network/format helpers and return the call logs."""
    if formats is None:
        formats = [{'url': 'https://cdn.example.com/video.mp4', 'format_id': '720'}]

    download_calls = []
    format_calls = []

    def fake_download_webpage(url, video_id, *args, **kwargs):
        download_calls.append((url, video_id))
        return webpage

    def fake_extract_formats(url, video_id, media_id, sources):
        format_calls.append((url, video_id, media_id, list(sources)))
        return formats

    monkeypatch.setattr(ie, '_download_webpage', fake_download_webpage)
    monkeypatch.setattr(ie, '_extract_formats', fake_extract_formats)

    if m:

    for expression in date_formats(day_first):

import pytest

from youtube_dl.extractor.fourtube import FourTubeBaseIE
from youtube_dl.extractor.common import InfoExtractor


def _make_ie(monkeypatch, tokens, calls=None):
    ie = FourTubeBaseIE()
    calls = {} if calls is None else calls

    def fake_download_json(url, video_id, **kwargs):
        calls['url'] = url
        calls['video_id'] = video_id
        calls['data'] = kwargs.get('data')
        calls['headers'] = kwargs.get('headers')
        return tokens

    monkeypatch.setattr(ie, '_download_json', fake_download_json)
    return ie, calls


def test_extract_formats_single_source(monkeypatch):
    tokens = {'720': {'token': 'https://cdn.example.com/720.mp4'}}
    ie, calls = _make_ie(monkeypatch, tokens)

    formats = ie._extract_formats(
        'https://www.4tube.com/videos/123/video-title',
        '123', 'media123', ['720'])

    assert calls['url'] == 'https://%s/media123/desktop/720' % ie._TKN_HOST
    assert calls['video_id'] == '123'
    assert calls['data'] == b''
    assert calls['headers'] == {
        'Origin': 'https://www.4tube.com',
        'Referer': 'https://www.4tube.com/videos/123/video-title',
    }

    assert formats == [{
        'url': 'https://cdn.example.com/720.mp4',
        'format_id': '720p',
        'resolution': '720p',
        'quality': 720,
    }]


def test_extract_formats_multiple_sources_sorted_and_joined(monkeypatch):
    tokens = {
        '240': {'token': 'https://cdn.example.com/240.mp4'},
        '480': {'token': 'https://cdn.example.com/480.mp4'},
        '1080': {'token': 'https://cdn.example.com/1080.mp4'},
    }
    ie, calls = _make_ie(monkeypatch, tokens)

    sort_calls = []
    real_sort_formats = InfoExtractor._sort_formats

    def tracking_sort_formats(formats, *args, **kwargs):
        sort_calls.append(list(formats))
        return real_sort_formats(ie, formats, *args, **kwargs)

    monkeypatch.setattr(ie, '_sort_formats', tracking_sort_formats)

    url = 'https://www.4tube.com:8080/videos/456?foo=bar#frag'
    formats = ie._extract_formats(url, '456', 'media456', ['240', '1080', '480'])

    # source list is joined with '+' in the token URL
    assert calls['url'] == 'https://%s/media456/desktop/240+1080+480' % ie._TKN_HOST
    assert calls['video_id'] == '456'
    assert calls['headers'] == {
        'Origin': 'https://www.4tube.com',
        'Referer': url,
    }

    # _sort_formats was invoked exactly once, on the built format list
    assert len(sort_calls) == 1
    assert len(sort_calls[0]) == 3

    assert len(formats) == 3
    by_id = {f['format_id']: f for f in formats}
    assert by_id['240p'] == {
        'url': 'https://cdn.example.com/240.mp4',
        'format_id': '240p',
        'resolution': '240p',
        'quality': 240,
    }
    assert by_id['480p']['quality'] == 480
    assert by_id['1080p']['url'] == 'https://cdn.example.com/1080.mp4'

    # sorting ran for real: highest quality first
    assert [f['quality'] for f in formats] == [1080, 480, 240]
    assert all(isinstance(f['quality'], int) for f in formats)


def test_extract_formats_uses_urlparse_for_origin(monkeypatch):
    tokens = {'480': {'token': 'https://cdn.example.com/480.mp4'}}
    ie, calls = _make_ie(monkeypatch, tokens)

    formats = ie._extract_formats(
        'http://sub.4tube.com/videos/789', '789', 'm789', ['480'])

import pytest

from youtube_dl.extractor.fourtube import FourTubeBaseIE
from youtube_dl.extractor.common import InfoExtractor


def _make_ie(monkeypatch, tokens, calls=None):
    ie = FourTubeBaseIE()
    calls = {} if calls is None else calls

    def fake_download_json(url, video_id, **kwargs):
        calls['url'] = url
        calls['video_id'] = video_id
        calls['data'] = kwargs.get('data')
        calls['headers'] = kwargs.get('headers')
        return tokens

    monkeypatch.setattr(ie, '_download_json', fake_download_json)
    return ie, calls


def test_extract_formats_single_source(monkeypatch):
    tokens = {'720': {'token': 'https://cdn.example.com/720.mp4'}}
    ie, calls = _make_ie(monkeypatch, tokens)

    formats = ie._extract_formats(
        'https://www.4tube.com/videos/123/video-title',
        '123', 'media123', ['720'])

    assert calls['url'] == 'https://%s/media123/desktop/720' % ie._TKN_HOST
    assert calls['video_id'] == '123'
    assert calls['data'] == b''
    assert calls['headers'] == {
        'Origin': 'https://www.4tube.com',
        'Referer': 'https://www.4tube.com/videos/123/video-title',
    }

    assert formats == [{
        'url': 'https://cdn.example.com/720.mp4',
        'format_id': '720p',
        'resolution': '720p',
        'quality': 720,
    }]


def test_extract_formats_multiple_sources_sorted_and_joined(monkeypatch):
    tokens = {
        '240': {'token': 'https://cdn.example.com/240.mp4'},
        '480': {'token': 'https://cdn.example.com/480.mp4'},
        '1080': {'token': 'https://cdn.example.com/1080.mp4'},
    }
    ie, calls = _make_ie(monkeypatch, tokens)

    sort_calls = []
    real_sort_formats = InfoExtractor._sort_formats

    def tracking_sort_formats(formats, *args, **kwargs):
        sort_calls.append(list(formats))
        return real_sort_formats(ie, formats, *args, **kwargs)

    monkeypatch.setattr(ie, '_sort_formats', tracking_sort_formats)

    url = 'https://www.4tube.com:8080/videos/456?foo=bar#frag'
    formats = ie._extract_formats(url, '456', 'media456', ['240', '1080', '480'])

    # source list is joined with '+' in the token URL
    assert calls['url'] == 'https://%s/media456/desktop/240+1080+480' % ie._TKN_HOST
    assert calls['video_id'] == '456'
    assert calls['headers'] == {
        'Origin': 'https://www.4tube.com',
        'Referer': url,
    }

    # _sort_formats was invoked exactly once, on the built format list
    assert len(sort_calls) == 1
    assert len(sort_calls[0]) == 3

    assert len(formats) == 3
    by_id = {f['format_id']: f for f in formats}
    assert by_id['240p'] == {
        'url': 'https://cdn.example.com/240.mp4',
        'format_id': '240p',
        'resolution': '240p',
        'quality': 240,
    }
    assert by_id['480p']['quality'] == 480
    assert by_id['1080p']['url'] == 'https://cdn.example.com/1080.mp4'

    # sorting ran for real: highest quality first
    assert [f['quality'] for f in formats] == [1080, 480, 240]
    assert all(isinstance(f['quality'], int) for f in formats)


def test_extract_formats_uses_urlparse_for_origin(monkeypatch):
    tokens = {'480': {'token': 'https://cdn.example.com/480.mp4'}}
    ie, calls = _make_ie(monkeypatch, tokens)

    formats = ie._extract_formats(
        'http://sub.4tube.com/videos/789', '789', 'm789', ['480'])

    # hostname strips port/userinfo; scheme is preserved from the parsed URL
    assert calls['headers']['Origin'] == 'http://sub.4tube.com'
    assert calls['headers']['Referer'] == 'http://sub.4tube.com/videos/789'
    assert formats[0]['format_id'] == '480p'

def _make_ie(monkeypatch, tokens, calls=None):
    ie = FourTubeBaseIE()
    calls = {} if calls is None else calls

    def fake_download_json(url, video_id, **kwargs):
        calls['url'] = url
        calls['video_id'] = video_id
        calls['data'] = kwargs.get('data')
        calls['headers'] = kwargs.get('headers')
        return tokens

    monkeypatch.setattr(ie, '_download_json', fake_download_json)

def test_extract_formats_single_source(monkeypatch):
    tokens = {'720': {'token': 'https://cdn.example.com/720.mp4'}}
    ie, calls = _make_ie(monkeypatch, tokens)

    formats = ie._extract_formats(
        'https://www.4tube.com/videos/123/video-title',
        '123', 'media123', ['720'])

    assert calls['url'] == 'https://%s/media123/desktop/720' % ie._TKN_HOST
    assert calls['video_id'] == '123'
    assert calls['data'] == b''
    assert calls['headers'] == {
        'Origin': 'https://www.4tube.com',
        'Referer': 'https://www.4tube.com/videos/123/video-title',
    }

    assert formats == [{
        'url': 'https://cdn.example.com/720.mp4',
        'format_id': '720p',
        'resolution': '720p',
        'quality': 720,
    }]


def test_extract_formats_multiple_sources_sorted_and_joined(monkeypatch):
    tokens = {
        '240': {'token': 'https://cdn.example.com/240.mp4'},
        '480': {'token': 'https://cdn.example.com/480.mp4'},
        '1080': {'token': 'https://cdn.example.com/1080.mp4'},
    }
    ie, calls = _make_ie(monkeypatch, tokens)

    sort_calls = []
    real_sort_formats = InfoExtractor._sort_formats

    def tracking_sort_formats(formats, *args, **kwargs):
        sort_calls.append(list(formats))
        return real_sort_formats(ie, formats, *args, **kwargs)

    monkeypatch.setattr(ie, '_sort_formats', tracking_sort_formats)

    url = 'https://www.4tube.com:8080/videos/456?foo=bar#frag'
    formats = ie._extract_formats(url, '456', 'media456', ['240', '1080', '480'])

    # source list is joined with '+' in the token URL
    assert calls['url'] == 'https://%s/media456/desktop/240+1080+480' % ie._TKN_HOST
    assert calls['video_id'] == '456'
    assert calls['headers'] == {
        'Origin': 'https://www.4tube.com',
        'Referer': url,
    }

    # _sort_formats was invoked exactly once, on the built format list
    assert len(sort_calls) == 1
    assert len(sort_calls[0]) == 3

    assert len(formats) == 3
    by_id = {f['format_id']: f for f in formats}
    assert by_id['240p'] == {
        'url': 'https://cdn.example.com/240.mp4',
        'format_id': '240p',
        'resolution': '240p',
        'quality': 240,
    }
    assert by_id['480p']['quality'] == 480
    assert by_id['1080p']['url'] == 'https://cdn.example.com/1080.mp4'

    # sorting ran for real: highest quality first
    assert [f['quality'] for f in formats] == [1080, 480, 240]

import pytest

from youtube_dl.extractor.fourtube import FourTubeBaseIE
from youtube_dl.extractor.common import InfoExtractor


def _make_ie(monkeypatch, tokens, calls=None):
    ie = FourTubeBaseIE()
    calls = {} if calls is None else calls

    def fake_download_json(url, video_id, **kwargs):
        calls['url'] = url
        calls['video_id'] = video_id
        calls['data'] = kwargs.get('data')
        calls['headers'] = kwargs.get('headers')
        return tokens

    monkeypatch.setattr(ie, '_download_json', fake_download_json)
    return ie, calls


def test_extract_formats_single_source(monkeypatch):
    tokens = {'720': {'token': 'https://cdn.example.com/720.mp4'}}
    ie, calls = _make_ie(monkeypatch, tokens)

    formats = ie._extract_formats(
        'https://www.4tube.com/videos/123/video-title',
        '123', 'media123', ['720'])

    assert calls['url'] == 'https://%s/media123/desktop/720' % ie._TKN_HOST
    assert calls['video_id'] == '123'
    assert calls['data'] == b''
    assert calls['headers'] == {
        'Origin': 'https://www.4tube.com',
        'Referer': 'https://www.4tube.com/videos/123/video-title',
    }

    assert formats == [{
        'url': 'https://cdn.example.com/720.mp4',
        'format_id': '720p',
        'resolution': '720p',
        'quality': 720,
    }]


def test_extract_formats_multiple_sources_sorted_and_joined(monkeypatch):
    tokens = {
        '240': {'token': 'https://cdn.example.com/240.mp4'},
        '480': {'token': 'https://cdn.example.com/480.mp4'},
        '1080': {'token': 'https://cdn.example.com/1080.mp4'},
    }
    ie, calls = _make_ie(monkeypatch, tokens)

    sort_calls = []
    real_sort_formats = InfoExtractor._sort_formats

    def tracking_sort_formats(formats, *args, **kwargs):
        sort_calls.append(list(formats))
        return real_sort_formats(ie, formats, *args, **kwargs)

    monkeypatch.setattr(ie, '_sort_formats', tracking_sort_formats)

    url = 'https://www.4tube.com:8080/videos/456?foo=bar#frag'
    formats = ie._extract_formats(url, '456', 'media456', ['240', '1080', '480'])

    # source list is joined with '+' in the token URL
    assert calls['url'] == 'https://%s/media456/desktop/240+1080+480' % ie._TKN_HOST
    assert calls['video_id'] == '456'
    assert calls['headers'] == {
        'Origin': 'https://www.4tube.com',
        'Referer': url,
    }

    # _sort_formats was invoked exactly once, on the built format list
    assert len(sort_calls) == 1
    assert len(sort_calls[0]) == 3

    assert len(formats) == 3
    by_id = {f['format_id']: f for f in formats}

    assert by_id['480p']['quality'] == 480

    assert [f['quality'] for f in formats] == [1080, 480, 240]

import pytest

from youtube_dl.extractor.fourtube import FourTubeBaseIE
from youtube_dl.extractor.common import InfoExtractor


def _make_ie(monkeypatch, tokens, calls=None):
    ie = FourTubeBaseIE()
    calls = {} if calls is None else calls

    def fake_download_json(url, video_id, **kwargs):
        calls['url'] = url
        calls['video_id'] = video_id
        calls['data'] = kwargs.get('data')
        calls['headers'] = kwargs.get('headers')
        return tokens

    monkeypatch.setattr(ie, '_download_json', fake_download_json)
    return ie, calls


def test_extract_formats_single_source(monkeypatch):
    tokens = {'720': {'token': 'https://cdn.example.com/720.mp4'}}
    ie, calls = _make_ie(monkeypatch, tokens)

    formats = ie._extract_formats(
        'https://www.4tube.com/videos/123/video-title',
        '123', 'media123', ['720'])

    assert calls['url'] == 'https://%s/media123/desktop/720' % ie._TKN_HOST
    assert calls['video_id'] == '123'
    assert calls['data'] == b''
    assert calls['headers'] == {
        'Origin': 'https://www.4tube.com',
        'Referer': 'https://www.4tube.com/videos/123/video-title',
    }

    assert formats == [{
        'url': 'https://cdn.example.com/720.mp4',
        'format_id': '720p',
        'resolution': '720p',
        'quality': 720,
    }]


def test_extract_formats_multiple_sources_sorted_and_joined(monkeypatch):
    tokens = {
        '240': {'token': 'https://cdn.example.com/240.mp4'},
        '480': {'token': 'https://cdn.example.com/480.mp4'},
        '1080': {'token': 'https://cdn.example.com/1080.mp4'},
    }
    ie, calls = _make_ie(monkeypatch, tokens)

    sort_calls = []
    real_sort_formats = InfoExtractor._sort_formats

    def tracking_sort_formats(formats, *args, **kwargs):
        sort_calls.append(list(formats))
        return real_sort_formats(ie, formats, *args, **kwargs)

    monkeypatch.setattr(ie, '_sort_formats', tracking_sort_formats)

    url = 'https://www.4tube.com:8080/videos/456?foo=bar#frag'
    formats = ie._extract_formats(url, '456', 'media456', ['240', '1080', '480'])

    # source list is joined with '+' in the token URL
    assert calls['url'] == 'https://%s/media456/desktop/240+1080+480' % ie._TKN_HOST
    assert calls['video_id'] == '456'
    assert calls['headers'] == {
        'Origin': 'https://www.4tube.com',
        'Referer': url,
    }

    # _sort_formats was invoked exactly once, on the built format list
    assert len(sort_calls) == 1
    assert len(sort_calls[0]) == 3

    assert len(formats) == 3
    by_id = {f['format_id']: f for f in formats}
    assert by_id['240p'] == {
        'url': 'https://cdn.example.com/240.mp4',
        'format_id': '240p',
        'resolution': '240p',
        'quality': 240,
    }
    assert by_id['480p']['quality'] == 480
    assert by_id['1080p']['url'] == 'https://cdn.example.com/1080.mp4'

    # sorting ran for real: highest quality first
    assert [f['quality'] for f in formats] == [1080, 480, 240]
    assert all(isinstance(f['quality'], int) for f in formats)


def test_extract_formats_uses_urlparse_for_origin(monkeypatch):
    tokens = {'480': {'token': 'https://cdn.example.com/480.mp4'}}
    ie, calls = _make_ie(monkeypatch, tokens)
